<!-- pr-reviewer: eb50df9716aeac3bdeb50333885c6a9a8d6a927f -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- `assets/ui/cube.png` is byte-identical to `v0.18.0` (same blob 800a69b68922).
- The new xtask test really fails on a missing path: with cube.png removed, `every_asset_a_packaging_script_names_exists` fails naming all five scripts (appimage, flatpak, linux, macos, snap); it is green with the file back. It scans `scripts/package-*.sh` plus `release.yml` as text, so it runs on every OS. It has a self-check (`seen > 0`) and a scan unit test.
- `PROCESS_VERSION` 56 -> 57 present (xtask is a process file). PR #1426 also uses 57; not a blocker, the later one takes the next number at merge.
- Decision file `docs/decisions/1428-restore-cube-icon.md` exists with what/why/dropped. No `.github`, script or dependency change; no build.rs.
- Trial merge with current main: clean.

Local results (merged with main)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask package_paths` | 3 passed |
| `cargo test -p xtask` (all) | 94 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking)
- macOS ICNS: `scripts/package-macos.sh:53,58` feeds `assets/ui/cube.png` to `sips`, whose output builds the iconset for `iconutil -c icns` (line 61). The missing cube.png is therefore the cause of the ICNS failure, and restoring it covers it. I could not run the macOS tools here, so that is read from the script, not run.
- Weak spot: `the_asset_directories_the_scripts_loop_over_exist` skips silently when a script or its `for asset in` line is missing (`continue`), so a renamed loop would stop being checked. Consider asserting at least one directory was checked.
- Scan only sees literal `assets/...` paths; variable-built paths are out of scope (stated in the code).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: eb50df9716aeac3bdeb50333885c6a9a8d6a927f -->

| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| issue worker | not known | not known | not known |
| review | Sonnet 5.5 | 76k | ~$0.21 |
Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted.
Effort: effort:low
